# Drivers: why Quarto-Needs exists

Requirements engineering starts before system requirements. The first layer records the concerns that justify the product; the second translates them into obligations for the system.

## Stakeholder needs

::: {.need #STK-001 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" tags="traceability;requirements-as-code"}
## Engineering teams need lifecycle-wide traceability

Teams need requirements, architecture decisions, implementation, tests, risks, and evidence to remain connected as the system evolves.
:::

::: {.need #STK-002 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" tags="documentation;quarto;usability"}
## Engineers need the engineering model to remain readable documentation

Formal traceability must not force teams to abandon explanatory prose, navigable documentation, or ordinary review workflows.
:::

::: {.need #STK-003 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" tags="governance;git;ci;reproducibility"}
## Teams need reproducible governance in Git and CI

Validation, baselines, quality gates, and impact analysis need deterministic behaviour that can participate in normal version-control workflows.
:::

::: {.need #STK-004 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" tags="architecture;adr;rationale"}
## Architecture choices need durable rationale and traceability

Engineers need to know not only what was required, but why architectural choices were made, where they apply, and how they are confirmed.
:::

::: {.need #STK-005 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" tags="localization;i18n;collaboration"}
## Multilingual teams need one engineering graph

Translations should improve communication without creating competing semantic models or duplicated engineering truth.
:::

## System requirements

::: {.need #SYS-001 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="graph;semantics;traceability" derives-from="STK-001" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS" verified-by="TC-001"}
## Maintain a canonical typed engineering graph

Quarto-Needs shall resolve engineering objects and typed relations into one canonical graph that supports deterministic traversal and validation.

### Rationale

A single graph provides the semantic substrate for queries, governance, baselines, impact analysis, and generated views.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-002 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="documentation;quarto;progressive-enhancement" derives-from="STK-002" implemented-by="COMP-EXTENSION" verified-by="TC-002"}
## Use Quarto as the executable documentation interface

Quarto-Needs shall make the engineering model navigable and publishable through ordinary Quarto documents while retaining machine-readable structure.

### Rationale

The documentation remains useful to humans while the same source carries formal engineering semantics.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-003 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="governance;determinism;ci" derives-from="STK-003" implemented-by="COMP-RULES;COMP-CLI" verified-by="TC-003"}
## Provide deterministic validation and quality gates

Quarto-Needs shall evaluate configured governance rules and quality gates reproducibly so that engineering policy can be enforced in local and CI workflows.

### Rationale

Requirements-as-code becomes operational only when the same project state produces the same engineering verdict.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-004 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="architecture;adr;decision" derives-from="STK-004" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS" verified-by="TC-004"}
## Treat architecture decisions as first-class engineering objects

Quarto-Needs shall model architecture decisions with identity, lifecycle, typed relations, governance, rationale, scope, confirmation, and lineage.

### Rationale

A decision is neither a requirement nor an implementation artifact; preserving it explicitly makes architectural reasoning traceable.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-005 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="localization;i18n;semantics" derives-from="STK-005" implemented-by="COMP-I18N" verified-by="TC-005"}
## Localize presentation without duplicating engineering semantics

Quarto-Needs shall allow translated narrative and titles while enforcing invariant IDs, types, statuses, attributes, and relations across languages.

### Rationale

The engineering graph must remain a single source of truth even when documentation serves multilingual teams.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-006 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="graph;projection;security;exploration" derives-from="STK-001;STK-002" implemented-by="COMP-GRAPH" verified-by="TC-006"}
## Publish bounded semantic graph projections for exploration

Quarto-Needs shall publish presentation-safe, bounded graph projections containing the semantics required by static and interactive views.

### Rationale

Exploration should be powerful without exposing arbitrary source data or moving engineering meaning into the browser.
:::
